[Document: Field Handbook on Paddy Pathology & Disease Management (DOA, 2023) | Section: 4.2 Brown Spot (Bipolaris oryzae)]
Brown Spot (Bipolaris oryzae) manifests primarily on seedlings and older leaves as distinct oval, dark brown spots with a grey or whitish center surrounded by a yellow halo. Severe infections also discolor grain hulls, reducing milling quality and germination rates. Management: Foliar application of Azoxystrobin 250 g/L SC at 15 mL per 16 L knapsack sprayer or Tebuconazole 250 g/L EC at 15-20 mL per 16 L sprayer. Maintain adequate soil potash (MOP) levels to enhance physiological resistance. Avoid water stress.

[Document: Organic and Integrated Pest Management in Sri Lankan Rice Ecosystems (RRDI, 2022) | Section: Chapter 6 Bio-Fungicides]
Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) applied at 50 g/L water provides effective prophylactic suppression against fungal conidia germination. Trichoderma viride enriched compost applied at 2.5 kg/ha improves root vigor and suppresses soil-borne inoculum.

[Document: Recommended Pesticides and Pre-Harvest Safety Periods (DOA, 2023) | Section: Table 3 Paddy Fungicides]
Azoxystrobin 250 g/L SC: Recommended rate 100 mL/acre. Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 14 days. Re-entry period: 24 hours.
